question: If (x + y)³ - (x - y)³ - 3y(2x² - 3y²) = ky³, then find the value of k.
solution:
**Concept used:**

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab (a + b)

(a - b)³ = a³ - b³ - 3ab (a - b)

**Calculations:**

(x + y)3 - (x - y)3 - 3y(2x2 - 3y2) = ky3

⇒ x3 + y3 + 3x²y + 3xy² - x3 + y3 + 3x²y - 3xy² - 6yx² + 9y³ = ky³

⇒ 11y3 = ky3

⇒ k = 11

∴ **The value of k is 11.**
